articleTitle: Research on the Problems and Countermeasures of Rural E-commerce under the Background of Rural Revitalization
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Rural E-commerce is an important means to promote the integrated development of primary, secondary and tertiary industries in rural areas, realizing agricultural modernization, and promoting farmers' income, it is an important way for china's rural poverty alleviation and well-off society in an all-round way. Promoting the sustainable and healthy development of rural e-commerce under the rural revitalization strategy has profound connotation and important significance. This paper analyzes the current situation and characteristics of rural e-commerce development, summarizing the existing problems, and putting forward countermeasures to provide effective practical basis for the development of rural e-commerce.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Application of Blockchain Technology in the Financial Industry
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Blockchain technology is widely used in the financial field. Blockchain technology can not only effectively change the flaws in the rules of the traditional financial system, but also accelerate the construction and development of a shared and win-win financial ecosystem. However, the blockchain technology itself is an emerging technology, and there are still some hidden risks in the process of application and operation. Therefore, we need to research and analyze the application of blockchain technology in the financial industry, and strengthen the supervision of blockchain technology. At the same time, we also need to explore the specific application of blockchain technology in the financial industry. In this way, we can not only accurately grasp the actual application of blockchain technology, but also promote the development of blockchain technology in the financial industry, thereby ensuring the security of blockchain technology in the application process.

articleTitle: Customer Satisfaction Evaluation of Food Delivery Platforms-Taking Meituan as an Example
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: This article takes Meituan as the research object, applies the ECSI structure model, establishes a Meituan takeaway satisfaction evaluation model based on three first-level indicators of perceived hardware quality, perceived software quality, and perceived service quality, and uses SPSS software to obtain The data is subjected to descriptive analysis, reliability testing, and satisfaction analysis. It can help take-out platforms and businesses to correctly understand and understand the service level and existing shortcomings of catering take-out companies, so as to provide the necessary basis for formulating relevant countermeasures to improve customer satisfaction.

articleTitle: Research on the Export Development of Small and Medium-sized Enterprises Cross-border E-commerce: Based on SWOT analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: The development of Internet technology has laid the foundation for the emergence and development of cross-border e-commerce. The rise of small-batch and multi-batch cross-border e-commerce retail B2C transactions has opened up a new path for small and medium-sized enterprises to develop foreign trade economy. There is a large number of Small and Medium-sized Enterprises in China with good flexibility. But in the process of developing cross-border e-commerce, SMEs are faced with difficulties in risk resistance, product homogeneity and funding. Unstable international situation, dangers of cross-border payment and high cross-border logistics costs also hindered the development of cross-border e-commerce. This paper designs a general strategy for SMEs to develop cross-border e-commerce with the help of favorable government policies and big data application technology. They should do a good job in brand building, actively explore overseas warehouse models, and seek financial support, cross-border payment and regulatory support from China government.

articleTitle: Research on the Innovation of China's Pension Insurance Transfer and Succession Model——Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: In the process of rapid economic development, the state must ensure the rationality and scientific nature of the relevant guarantee system, so as to promote stable economic development. However, there are some problems in the current transfer and continuation model of China's pension insurance, which will affect the flow of labor to a certain extent. The transfer and continuation of pension insurance will cause migrant workers to give up corresponding insurance rights and affect the vigorous development of China's labor market. Therefore, we must study and analyze the transfer and continuation model of China's pension insurance. The application of big data technology has a certain significance in the innovation research work of pension insurance transfer and continuation model. Big data technology can not only provide comprehensive data information for the pension insurance transfer and continuation model, but also can effectively improve the pension insurance transfer and continuation model. This requires us to research and analyze the problems of pension insurance transfer and continuation models, and build a new intelligent pension insurance model based on big data. Only in this way can it be ensured that the pension insurance transfer and continuation model meets the mobility needs of the Chinese labor market and promotes the stable development of the Chinese economy.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Big Data to Audit
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: The widespread application of Big data technology has brought a profound impact on the national economic and social operation, and it is gradually affecting the development direction of the audit industry. The application of big data technology has brought a certain influence on the scope of the audit, audit methods, and audit risks. This paper will put forward relevant suggestions and measures in response to a series of impacts brought by Big data to promote the better development of the audit industry.

articleTitle: Statistical Analysis on the Change of Economic Condition in China Under the Influence of COVID-19
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: The outbreak of coronavirus (Covid-19) has a significant impact on the global economy since the beginning of 2020. Chinese government has come up with multiple policies in response to Covid-19 emergency. The policies include social-distancing regulations, lockdowns and other relevant aspects, and then the personal income of the society is changed accordingly. From the macroeconomic perspective, the investment situation in different industries is different. It also has significant impact on the investment habits in the Chinese market after Covid-19. The economic data in China shows the significant effects. Correlation is a statistic that measures the degree to which two sets of data move consistently to each other. Based on the statistical analysis, this paper offers in-depth insight of the economy as well as relevant study.

articleTitle: Analysis of Factors Affecting the Sales of Popular Science Books Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: The consumption data of popular science books on Taobao is obtained by using the technology of web crawler, and an empirical study is carried out on the indexes that affect the sales. Through the research, it is found that the sales rank of search engines, the price, the quantity and quality and content of online reviews have a significant impact on the sales of popular science books. Although the basic variable is an important reference index for consumers to make decisions, it has no significant impact on sales. As an important manifestation of the value of popular science books, price has a positive impact on sales, but buyers are usually willing to pay a certain premium for high-quality products. Sales rank is an important function of major e-commerce websites, which has a strong correlation and boosting effect with sales. Different variables have different effects on the sales of popular science books.

articleTitle: Research on the Development of Retail E-commerce in China from the Perspective of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: After more than 20 years of development, China's retail e-commerce industry shows an explosive growth trend. At the present stage, the over-speed growth of the retail e-commerce industry has gradually leveled off, with many platforms showing a trend of giant standing. The rapid rise of emerging technologies such as big data, artificial intelligence and cloud computing has brought new opportunities and challenges to the development of retail e-commerce, and further exposed the problems of retail e-commerce. In order to satisfy consumers' high-quality and high-demand experience in the future, this paper puts forward countermeasures to improve the development of retail e-commerce in China based on the analysis of big data.

articleTitle: Research on Public Safety Management under the Application of Big Data and Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: In the era of accelerating development of big data and the Internet of Things, the application of the Internet of Things and big data technology in the field of urban public safety management is becoming more and more common. This has had a positive impact on public safety management to a certain extent. However, there are some risks in its actual application. In order to improve the application level of big data and IoT technology, we need to research and analyze the public safety management system under big data and IoT applications, and discuss the risks and advantages brought by big data and IoT technology. At the same time, the author proposes effective countermeasures to try to solve the risks in the field of public safety management under the application of big data and the Internet of Things, which is conducive to improving the level of public safety management.

articleTitle: Gradient Projection, Karush-Khun-Tucker Method for Economic Dispatch and DC Optimal Power Flow System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: The Economic Dispatch and Direct Current Optimal Power Flow (DCOPF) are significant functions in the modern energy system. It consists in programming the electric production correctly with minimum operational cost. In the current study, methods of Karush-Kuhn-Tucker and Gradient Projection are applied to optimize the economic dispatch and DCOPF systems. In addition, the algorithms deliver the optimization results for economic dispatch and DCOPF problem and the influence of constraints is compared and discussed. Also, the convergence rate and calculation accuracy of each method are compared and discussed regarding the complexity of the system.

articleTitle: Research on the Development Strategy of AI Technology Based on the Internet Plus Era
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: "Internet plus" is the integration of Internet and traditional industries through information communication technology and Internet platform, thus giving birth to new economic form and providing environment for public entrepreneurship and innovation. The essence of "Internet plus" is the online and traditional data of traditional industries. In this era of Internet plus, the power of AI is booming. This article expounds the connotation of "Internet plus" and Ai, and introduces the application and popularization of the technology in depth integration with traditional industries, and looks into the new development trend and strategies of its future development.

articleTitle: Construction of Farmer's Financing Mode Under Internet Finance Embedded
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Under the guidance of rural revitalization strategy, as the main body of agricultural economy, the development of farmers has become an important factor. The natural attributes of agricultural products and other factors cause farmers to face financing difficulties, financing expensive dilemma. The financial model of Internet embedded in agriculture to a great extent alleviates the financing pressure of farmers. Through the questionnaire survey of farmers and the analysis of AHP, it is found that the value chain risk is taken as the standard layer of the choice of Internet financial model, and farmers are more concerned about the risk of enterprise financial management and credit risk.

articleTitle: The current situation of China's governance from the perspective of smart government
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Chinese electronic government is currently in full swing to the stage of smart government. The government can provide multi-directional and personalized public services, breaking through the limitations of time, space and region, which will profoundly change the government governance model and the people's lifestyle in the future. First of all, based on the statistical data of 36 typical cities and national administrative colleges in China, this paper uses the method of comparative analysis to find out the main problems of the intelligent government platform in China. Finally, this paper makes route optimization to improve smart government and public service for the better.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Correlation between Operating Capital Management and Operating Performance-Taking the Communication Terminal and Accessories Industry as an example
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: This article uses Stata16.0 software tools to analyze and research the 2015-2019 company annual reports of listed companies in the communication terminal and accessories industry collected in the RESSET financial research database, and summarizes the impact of short-term operating funds on operating performance in the company's supply, production and sales scenarios, provides reference suggestions and valuable experience for companies of different sizes in the communication terminal and accessories industry and other industries in the use of short-term operating funds, and promotes the sustainable and healthy development of enterprises.

articleTitle: The development status and legal supervision of robo-advisors under financial technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: This article introduces the development background of robo-advisors under fintech, expounds the current legal regulatory dilemmas from the perspective of robo-advisors, financial market, investors, and regulatory requirements, and proposes the supervision suggestions for the development of robot consultants in the future.

articleTitle: Brief Analysis Report on Mobile Payment Usage of Middle School Students in the New Financial Environment
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: This paper analyzes the impact of social network and mobile payment on finance from the perspective of senior high students. Advantages like low-cost, high accuracy and particularly handy, have great effect on consumer groups like middle school students.We mainly focused on investigating and analyzing what will mobile payments effect on their consumption behavior in this paper. On the basis of the investigation, students' consumption behavior is more likely being random so non-cash payment will increase and stimulate the consumption.

articleTitle: Nomination of directors, agency costs and investment efficiency
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Listed companies usually set up anti-takeover clauses in their articles of association to resist the risk of hostile merger control transfer. Based on the anti-takeover clause, this paper takes the financial data of all A listed companies in Shanghai and Shenzhen for 2014-2018 as a sample. This paper explores the influence of director nomination on investment efficiency and the intermediary effect of agency cost between them. The research show s that the establishment of director nomination clause in the articles of association has a positive impact on investment efficiency, and further research shows that agency cost plays an intermediary role in it, that is, director nomination right improves investment efficiency by reducing agency cost. This paper studies the transmission path of director nomination right affecting investment efficiency in order to provide theoretical reference for the legislative perfection of anti-takeover clause in China.

articleTitle: Voice Conversion from Tibetan Amdo Dialect to Tibetan U-tsang Dialect Based on StarGAN-VC2
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: This paper proposes a conversion method from Tibetan Amdo dialect to Tibetan U-tsang dialect based on StarGAN-VC2. Recently, StarGAN-VC has gained increasing public attention due to use of a single build network. However, this method exits a difference between the converted result and the real speech. In order to alleviate this problem, the model proposes in this paper has been improved in the training part and the network architecture respectively. The training part proposes a source and target conditional adversarial loss, which allows all source domain data to be converted into target domain data. In the aspect of network architecture, a modulation-based dynamic approach is proposed, which can transform acoustic feature modulation in a specific way. Subjective and objective evaluations indicate that StarGAN-VC2 is superior to StarGAN-VC in naturalness and similarity.

articleTitle: Application research of Big data in provincial important Product traceability system
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, big data technology fusion of Internet of Things technology has been better applied in provincial important product traceability. As a provincial important product traceability system connecting all links from planting, breeding, production and processing to logistics, transportation and sales, it generates a huge database of data every day. So big data technology is needed for data analysis and data mining to improve economic efficiency for government decisions, for industries/enterprises, and for social development.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Livestreaming E-Commerce Mode
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Livestreaming E-commerce rose in 2016 and achieved explosive growth in 2019, which has attracted extensive attention of the society. The construction of this new business mode mainly involves brands, MCN institutions, streamers, livestreaming e-commerce platforms, consumers and other participants. This paper will study the participants in the construction of livestreaming e-commerce mode and the relationship between them.

articleTitle: Research on the Relevance of Big Data Accounting and Financial Information
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: This article combines the relevance of big data accounting and financial information, and analyzes the difference between big data accounting and traditional accounting. The research content of this paper includes many aspects such as the change of thinking mode, fragmented or unstructured, data system structure, and the manifestation of information value. The author studied descriptive statistics, correlation testing, regression and analysis, robustness testing, and so on. The purpose of the research is to improve the effect of corporate financial information management and promote the sustainable development of the corporate economy.

articleTitle: Revisiting the Mediating Effect between Market Orientation and New Product Innovation Performance: Competitive Intensity and Sensemaking as Moderator
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: The knowledge of value and diversity is the source of firm's competitive advantage, and that a most core assumption of knowledge-based view is that it is the integration of units' inner firm instead of knowledge itself that accumulates the competitive advantage. Based on knowledge-based theory, a questionnaire survey of 335 firms in China was conducted to empirically analyze the relationship between market orientation, absorptive capacity, and new product innovation performance. The article found that the absorptive capacity mediates the relationship between market orientation and new product performance, and competitive intensity, sensemaking negative adjusts the relationship between market orientation and absorptive capacity. This study shows that firms need to identify useful knowledge from complex market information and technical information, and that firms and employees need to digest and absorb a large amount of information and convert them into knowledge, which promote firm form ability that is absorptive capacity to gain a competitive advantage. Firms should have a sense of risk and maintain a high sensemaking to external environment.

articleTitle: The Course Reform of Electronic Control of Machine Tool and PLC based on the Virtual Simulation Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Virtual simulation technology can reproduce the actual conditions and make the experimental project more engineering. The technology can make students free from the limitation of time and space and be able to practice anytime and anywhere. It not only greatly improves students' learning efficiency, but also promotes the connection between curriculum and practice teaching and strengthens the integration of theory teaching and practice teaching. At the same time, the automatic scoring function of virtual simulation system can help students get timely feedback, so as to find and solve problems in time, which plays a very important role in promoting the timely adjustment of curriculum arrangement and deepening of teaching reform. Based on idea of "student-centered", the course of electronic control of machine tool and PLC introduces the virtual simulation technology and carries out the course reform. This paper introduces the process of curriculum reform from the aspects of course reform ideas, concrete measures and evaluation reform. From the perspective of student feedback, course reform not only improves the subjective initiative of students, but also improves the teaching effect significantly.

articleTitle: Life Satisfaction Research-Quantitative Analysis Based on Wuhan City
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: According to the concept of life satisfaction of Huebner, Drane and Valois, using the survey data of the Institute of Social Development of Wuhan University, to carry out empirical research on life satisfaction. The variables of sociodemographic factors, economic factors and social environmental factors have good explanatory power for residents' life satisfaction.

articleTitle: A review of Research on the Continuous Use of Mobile Short Video Application Users
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Based on the research status of mobile short video application user adoption / continuous use, this paper summarizes the concept definition, basic theory and application situation, influencing factors and other aspects of mobile short video application, and discusses the shortcomings of current research and the future research direction.

articleTitle: The Influence of "Golden Tax Third Period" on Enterprise Tax-related Services
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: It has been 11 years since "Golden Tax Third Period" was launched in 2009.The process of China's tax informatization has also been gradually transformed from China's Tax Collection and Management Information System (CTAIS) to the Golden Tax Third Period system. As for enterprises, what new changes will appear in the process of popularizing the "Golden Tax Third Period"? What kind of influence will it bring to the tax-related services of enterprises? This paper will take the "Golden Tax Third Period" as the background, tax related services and risk response as the entry point, discuss the tax related services of enterprises and put forward some suggestions to help enterprises better adapt to the "Golden Tax Third Period".

articleTitle: Delicious and Profitable ---Evaluation of Profitability of Food Processing Listed Companies in China
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Based on the financial data in 2019, of 47 listed companies of food processing, the paper constructs a profitability evaluation system including 8 financial indicators, and uses factor analysis to analyze the three ability dimensions of profit-earning, profit-quality, and profit-growth, to evaluate the profitability of the selected listed companies. The delicious foodstuffs and profitable ability both are the objectives of the listed companies of food processing. The measures to improve the profitability are given for the listed companies of food processing.

articleTitle: Exploration of the Digital Transformation of Traditional Enterprise Financial Management under the Background of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: This article mainly briefly describes some related concepts of the digital transformation of financial management of traditional enterprises under the background of big data. The author analyzes some opportunities and challenges that companies need to face in the process of digital transformation. Moreover, the author also discusses and explains how companies can transform and upgrade, hoping to effectively help companies realize the importance of completing financial digital transformation in the era of big data. Enterprises should actively change their internal financial management methods and gradually improve their own capabilities and competitiveness in the market.

articleTitle: Efficiency Assessing of Earthquake Agency Microblog Platform Based on DEA Approach
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: With the advent of new media era, microblog plays an increasingly important role in the release of earthquake information and the dissemination of popular knowledge on earthquake prevention and disaster reduction by virtue of its advantages such as interactivity, immediacy and fast information push. In this paper, 30 provincial earthquake agency certification of the earthquake agency weibo as the research object, based on the analysis of the efficiency of microblogging operations with multiple inputs and multiple outputs, using the total number of days of microblogging operations and the total number of tweets as input indicators and the number of followers, retweets, comments, and compliments as output indicators. Finally, quantitative analysis of indicator data using the CCR and BCC models in the DEA approach. Overall, the microblog operating efficiency of Earthquake Agency has poor performance, which needs to be further strengthened on the effective allocation of resources and management level.

articleTitle: Scale Benefit Analysis of Cities in Jiangxi Province : Based on Grey Incidence Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: City scale benefit refers to the comprehensive benefit of cities, which includes economic, social and environmental benefit. By selecting 20 indicators which can fully reflect city scale benefit and using grey relational analysis, this paper analyzes statistical data in 2018 of 11 cities in Jiangxi Province. On the basis of correlation coefficient comparison and clusters of grey incidences, corresponding strategies of city scale benefit are put forward.

articleTitle: Analysis of consumers’ perception and purchasing intention toward organic food based upon the Theory of Planned Behavior
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: The demand for organic agricultural products in China is expected to have a huge increase due to the new food safety policies and the expansion of middle classes. At the same time, consumers have been increasingly concern about health and environmental issues. Organic food, an emerging market that represents healthier lifestyle, better taste and safer environment, is being recognized by people from different classes. Exploring this market from the side of consumers' perception is rather meaningful and important. The Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB) model has been studied and applied to psychology and behaviors. Together with statistical measures, TPB and other factors can be applied to explore people's purchasing intentions.

articleTitle: Research On Sapiential Financial Management Mode Based On Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Artificial intelligence has opened a new management mode of enterprises, changed the traditional operation of enterprises, and put forward the requirement of upgrading the traditional financial ideas and financial processing system -- applying the sapiential financial management mode to realize the sapientia financial management. Based on artificial intelligence technology of financial information and the influence of the financial management function, this paper explore new models of artificial intelligence in the era of financial management to build sapientia financial management model based on artificial intelligence, help enterprise prospectie analysis using sapientia technology resources and avoid the enterprise's financial risk, improve financial management efficiency and achieve higher business performance.

articleTitle: Multi-source Heterogeneous Data Association Technology to Build Public Safety Big Data Integration Research
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: This article analyzes the principles of building public safety big data integration. The content of this article includes advancement, stability, security, etc. The author studied the overall function design, background management design, data collection formatting design, mobile terminal function design, data collection system design, data collection design, system interface design, system security design, push service design, document analysis service design, etc. The purpose of this paper is to give full play to the application value of multi-source heterogeneous technology and improve the application effect of the integrated public safety big data system.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Singapore’s "Smart Nation" Based on the TRT Model Perspective
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Singapore is the first country in the world to introduce the "Smart Nation 2025 Plan". Its e-government construction has always been in the forefront of the world, especially in the construction of smart cities. Research on the construction of Singapore's "smart nation" is an important reference for China's current smart city construction. Based on the perspective of the TRT model, this article summarizes the measures taken in the process of building a smart country in Singapore from the perspective of big data as technology, resources, and concepts and puts forward further countermeasures based on the actual situation of smart country building in China.

articleTitle: Consumption Behavior of Popular Science Books Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Internet big data provides increasingly rich technical means for science popularization, which has brought about a great change in the consumption mode of popular science books. The consumption scene, payment mode, factors affecting the selection, consumption time period, emotional characteristics of public popular science books have changed greatly. This paper uses big data to get the consumption data of popular science books on e-commerce websites. Based on a comprehensive analysis of each dimension of public popular science books in various dimensions, this paper summarizes the changes of the public's consumption of popular science books, and puts forward research programs in the field of popular science book consumption, as well as related safety issues.

articleTitle: Research expenditure and enterprise performance of science and technology enterprises
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: In recent years, China has put forward five development concepts, among which innovation is the most important. As the main body of scientific and technological innovation, enterprises should increase R & D expenditure to enhance the core competitiveness of enterprises. This paper uses correlation analysis and regression model to examine the relationship between R & D expenditure and enterprise performance of technology-based enterprises. The results show that monetary capital will make enterprises carry out more R & D expenditure. R & D expenditure has a significant impact on the operating income of the current year, but has no significant impact on the operating profit of that year. It is hoped that the conclusion of this paper can provide a theoretical basis for scientific and technological companies to carry out R & D activities and further enrich relevant research.

articleTitle: Research on Fresh Agricultural Product Inventory Management under Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Based on the analysis of the characteristics of fresh agricultural products, the functions of inventory control and the components of the model, according to the characteristics of the deterioration and demand of fresh agricultural products, this article uses an improved method of economic ordering and batching, focusing on time affecting demand and Deterioration rate, price affects demand, customer waiting time affects the shortage and part of the lagging supply rate and other factors, focusing on the fresh agricultural product inventory control model. At the same time, a fresh agricultural product inventory management system based on a big data platform is constructed, and a strategy for constructing an e-commerce platform for fresh agricultural products based on big data under the Internet environment is proposed.

articleTitle: Data-driven Scene Marketing Based on Consumer Insight
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Scene marketing is a new marketing mode under which specific scenarios are created to show product functions, highlight product features, address pain points of consumers, add consumer experience, build emotional resonance with consumers and promote sales. It relies on accurate consumer insight, efficient and scientific analysis of consumption data. Scene marketing based on consumer insight can meet consumer demands accurately, hit pain points of consumers directly, reduce blind marketing costs and match the four elements of marketing effectively, forming a gradual consumption cultivation process.

articleTitle: The Value of Business Analytics in China’s Companies : A Statistical Research Based on Firm-Level Surveys
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: As a growing number of companies emphasize the core focus on analyzing the generated data and hold data-driven decision-making in esteem, quantitative methods and data modeling have been widely used for a variety of purposes in recent years [1]. Although there is no doubt in the great value brought by business analytics, very little attention has been paid to the specific effects from the perspective of the enterprises, nor empirically or statistically verified at a large scale. This prospective study sets out to obtain first-hand data from carefully designed questionnaires and theoretically investigate the impact of business analytics on market performance, work efficiency, and operational costs. This is one of the first attempts to quantitively analyze their relationship and will generate fresh insights into the field of corporate governance and business management. The questionnaires were distributed among 1781 firms in China, which are divided into the control group and experimental group based on their responses. By comparison, the results demonstrate that business analytics gives a big push in enhancing market performance, boosting work efficiency, and reducing operational costs.

articleTitle: Based on WeChat Analysis of Social Platform Value Co-Creation Theory
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: In the Internet environment, more and more companies are beginning to operate on platforms. As far as the social field is concerned, a large number of outstanding companies have emerged in the past ten years. At present, WeChat is not only limited to a communication tool, it has become a way of life. Focusing on the core function of communication, WeChat has developed into an open platform integrating social interaction, information, and services. Its products and services are integrated into people's lives like water and electricity. Since its establishment in 2011, WeChat has achieved breakthrough growth many times, creating a historical miracle of China's Internet and becoming a textbook case. According to the business expansion process, the development process of WeChat can be summarized into three stages: the "social" platform stage, the "social + information" platform stage, and the "social ten information + service" platform stage.

articleTitle: Photoplethysmographic Signals Identification Method Based On Image Coding
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: The pulse wave signal has non-stationary and non-linear characteristics. In order to apply the advantages of neural network recognition on 2D images to pulse wave identification, a Gram angle field-convolutional neural network (PPG-GAF-CNN) pulse wave identification model is proposed. Using the two methods of Gram angle difference field (GADF) and Gram angle sum field (GASF) in the Gram angle field (GAF) to converting the pulse wave signal into a 2-D image, extract the image features and input the optimized CNN Model, obtaining the ideal recognition accuracy. By studying the influence of network parameters, different network layers and different diagnosis methods on the fault diagnosis model, the optimal combination of models is constructed. The test results show that GADF-CNN has higher recognition accuracy than the GASF-CNN, which has a reliable effect in pulse wave identification.

articleTitle: Research on M&A Performance in the Iron and Steel Industry: Based on Financial Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Economic development has entered the "new normal", and the supply-side structural reforms proposed "three eliminations, one reduction, and one supplement", making the steel industry, which is already unfavorable, more difficult. The development of the steel industry is not only related to itself but also closely related to the development of the entire economy. In the case of overproduction and hindered development in the steel industry of its financial big data, the merger and reorganization of steel companies are not only to enhance the competitiveness of enterprises but also to better promote the further development and management information level of the steel industry and optimize the allocation of resources in the steel industry. However, can the merger and reorganization of steel companies achieve good merger performance? To determine this, the research based on financial big data on the performance of mergers and acquisitions between companies in the steel industry has become particularly important, and this research has certain significance for improving the management information level of M&A projects.

articleTitle: Research on Sina Weibo Altmetrics Index about Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: [Purpose/significance] In order to explore the social public's emotional tendency towards academic achievements on social platforms and whether academic information will cause certain social risks to scholars when facing the public with great differences. [Method/process] Links to original texts of all academic information related to Sina Weibo provided by Altmetric company from October 2011 to October 2017 have been selected. On this basis, python was used to crawl Sina Weibo comment data, and a total of 53826 valid comment data were obtained, which constituted the basic data set of this study for emotional analysis. [Result/conclusion] The research finds that different scholars and the public have a greater acceptance of networked academic information, and the emotional tendency of Sina Weibo data comments is generally positive. However, if the original Sina Weibo has ambiguous or extreme comments, the public may have negative emotions due to misunderstanding of the original text and attacks on these extreme comments. This paper also tries to introduce The Schwartz value Scale from the micro perspective and put forward the idea of emotional evaluation of Sina Weibo academic information review based on values, in order to provide more detailed thinking of emotion dimension for the study of Altmetrics index from the perspective of emotion analysis.

articleTitle: Research on Evaluation of Operation Effect of Military-Civil Integration in Military Industry Enterprises---Take Aviation Industry Corporation L as an Example
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: The capabilities of military-civilian integration can be subdivided into institutional arrangements of military-civilian integration, innovation, the transformation of the intellectual property rights (IPR), and comprehensive capabilities based on collaboration and operation under the perspective of collaboration and innovation of military-civilian technology. It is helpful to make a quantitative evaluation of the military-civilian integration of a certain area and enterprise through measurements at multiple levels and dimensions. This essay takes the aviation industry L corporation as an example to evaluate its military-civilian integration by making use of an AHP-fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method and building a military-civilian integration evaluation system. Regarding the problems including irrational existing structure, insufficient funds, weak technological innovation capabilities, and the low level of transformation of scientific and technological achievements, related measures were proposed, such as optimizing product structure, broadening financing channels, strengthening talent team and resource sharing as well as collaboration and innovation.

articleTitle: Joint Ordering and Inventory Decision Model with Multi-item Life-limiting Consumable Materials
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: If the procurement department reasonably determines the purchase volume and inventory level of equipment spare parts, balances inventory investment and guarantee a rate, it can use and plan support resources more scientifically. The article analyzes a multi-variety equipment joint ordering and inventory strategy and establishes a joint ordering model based on the optimal service life and purchase batch size. The total amount of discount strategy can be considered to ensure that the cost is minimized. Secondly, in order to facilitate the procurement work, the optimal procurement cycle was revised based on the second power strategy of Monte Carlo simulation, and the deviation error test of the optimal total cost was performed on the solution result. Finally, the combined ordering and inventory model is solved based on the case data, and the sensitive value analysis of the parameters is performed to verify the effectiveness of the model.
